headline: Executive order signed December 11, 2025, addresses proxy advisory firms, focusing on those that are foreign-owned or seen as politically motivated.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order concerns proxy advisors, the firms that advise investors on how to vote on shareholder matters at public companies. It points to firms that are foreign-owned or that the order describes as politically motivated. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, agency actions, or deadlines in the order are not known from this source.

who_it_affects.how: The order appears to target how these firms operate, especially those with foreign ownership.

who_it_affects.group: Investors and shareholders, including people with retirement or investment accounts
who_it_affects.how: The order may change the advice their fund managers rely on when voting shares on their behalf.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 11, 2025; specific effective dates not stated in the available material.
